items.reason: This describes a missing end_timestamp_precise field causing a KeyError during batch processing. None of the golden issues describes this input-handling problem.
Both describe the reduced redirect-walk limit preventing trees deeper than 1000 from resolving to the correct segment root.
Both describe reusing existing Redis set key names for sorted sets, causing WRONGTYPE failures on in-flight keys during rollout.
Both describe removal of the configurable max_segment_spans enforcement and its replacement with a hardcoded Lua cap of 1000.
Both describe missing coverage for timestamp-based ordering and eviction because fixtures use identical timestamps and never exceed the cap.
The comment includes the same ignored max_segment_spans setting and hardcoded Lua cap. Its additional concern about lost trimming signals does not change that match.
